= Phase 1: Inventory & Mapping
:author: AI Assistant
:revdate: 2026-02-08
:toc: left
:toclevels: 3
:icons: font

== Overview

Complete inventory and mapping of all systemd units, scripts, and dependencies in the RKE2Lab environment. This phase provides the foundation for systematic refactoring by documenting the current state.

[NOTE]
====
**Architecture Evolution**: The legacy systemd-based Nix build services (`rke2lab-flox-build.service` and `rke2lab-flox-build@.service`) have been superseded by initContainer-based builds in the Flox runtime DaemonSet. These services are documented as historical reference only and have been removed from the codebase. See `rke2.d/bioskop/master/catalog/runtime/flox-containerd-shim/10-daemonset.yaml` for the current implementation.
====

== Objectives

* Catalog all custom systemd service and target files
* Map all helper scripts and their invocations
* Document dependency chains and boot ordering
* Create old → new name mappings for renaming phase
* Identify redundancies and simplification opportunities

== Dependency Chains

=== Before Refactoring

.Boot Flow (Target-Based)
----
rke2-server.service
  ↓
rke2lab-runtime-manifests-install.service
  ↓
rke2lab-runtime-ready-check.service
  ↓
rke2lab-runtime-ready.target ← rke2lab-storage-manifests-install.service
  ↓
rke2lab-storage-ready-check.service
  ↓
rke2lab-storage-ready.target ← rke2lab-networking-manifests-install.service
  ↓
rke2lab-networking-ready-check.service
  ↓
rke2lab-networking-ready.target ← rke2lab-replication-manifests-install.service
  ↓
rke2lab-replication-ready-check.service
  ↓
rke2lab-replication-ready.target ← rke2lab-mesh-manifests-install.service
  ↓
rke2lab-mesh-ready-check.service
  ↓
rke2lab-mesh-ready.target ← tekton/gitops manifests
----

*Problem*: Each target waits for only one service, providing no value. The separate ready services add complexity.

=== After Refactoring (Phases 2, 3, 3.5)

.Boot Flow (Service-Based)
----
rke2-server.service
  ↓
rke2lab-runtime-manifests.service (with ExecStartPost ready check)
  ↓
rke2lab-storage-manifests.service (After=runtime, ExecStartPost ready check)
  ↓
rke2lab-networking-manifests.service (After=storage, ExecStartPost ready check)
  ↓
rke2lab-replication-manifests.service (After=networking, ExecStartPost ready check)
  ↓
rke2lab-mesh-manifests.service (After=replication, ExecStartPost ready check)
  ↓
tekton/gitops manifests (After=mesh)
----

*Benefits*: 
* Direct dependencies (clearer)
* Integrated readiness (fewer files)
* No redundant targets
* Fail-fast preserved via ExecStartPost

== Identified Simplification Opportunities

=== Naming Standardization
* Remove `-install` suffix from manifests services (all install manifests)
* Remove `-check` suffix from ready services/scripts (all check readiness)

=== Structural Simplification
* Integrate readiness checks into manifests services as `ExecStartPost`
* Eliminate separate ready services (5 files)
* Eliminate redundant targets with single dependencies (6 files)

=== Expected Impact
* *11 fewer files* (5 services + 6 targets)
* *Simpler dependencies* (service → service vs service → ready → target → service)
* *Preserved guarantees* (boot ordering, fail-fast behavior)
